Kīcaka
------------------------------------------
Kīcaka is one of the evil characters of the Mahābhārata. He was demoniac by nature and was the commander-in-chief of the army of the king विराट. When the Pāṇḍavas, along with द्रौपदी, were living in Virāṭanagarī incognito, कीचक tried to molest द्रौपदी but was killed by भीम who was hiding nearby. Later भीम despatched the 105 Upakīcakas also (Kīcaka’s brothers) to the world of यम, since they tried to burn द्रौपदी alive.
